messages:
Ava: Quick sync — we need a final keyword + redirect handoff for the webinar landing. Can we agree on canonical, immediate redirects for old promo pages, and a short internal linking matrix? Launch in 48h.
Marco: On it. My proposed checklist:
- primary KW set (3) for hero + H1
- longtail targets in FAQ
- schema: Event + FAQ + Organization
- redirects: 301 from /promo/* -> /webinar/2026...
Priya: Can you add the recommended anchor text for the internal links? I can slot into the post-launch social copy.
Eli: Also need UTM mapping for inbound routing — want to send webinar signups to Growth SF CRM queue. Who owns the routing values?
Marco: I'll drop the KW list and redirect snippet. For anchors: use product-feature + 'LLM inference at scale' when linking from docs.

Marco: KW list: 1) 'low-latency LLM inference' 2) 'inference cost optimization' 3) 'private LLM deployment'
Marco: Redirect snippet (nginx):
```
location ~ ^/promo/(.*)$ {
  return 301 /webinar/2026-06-$1;
}
```
Marco: JSON-LD event example to add to head:
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference: Webinar — Serving LLMs in Prod","startDate":"2026-06-10T16:00:00Z","eventAttendanceMode":"https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode","organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Priya: For internal linking matrix: Homepage -> Product page (hero) -> Webinar landing -> Docs deep-link (how to integrate). Labels: 'Use cases', 'Performance', 'Getting started', 'Webinar'.
Ava: Confirm canonical: webinar landing should canonical to itself, old promo pages 301 -> webinar, don't use meta refresh. Also keep og:image from assets repo v2.
Eli: UTM plan: utm_source=redwood-email, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=webinar_jun2026. Growth to ingest utm_campaign into CRM field 'promo_source'.
seo-bot: crawl-report: 12 pages with missing schema found; suggested to add FAQ or Event where applicable. (auto-scan)
Marco: Action items: I'll commit redirect rules to infra repo PR; Priya will update content anchors; Eli will send CRM mapping to eng-forms; Ava will sign off on assets.
Ava: Thanks — can we get final PR + content by EOD today? :thumbsup:
Priya: Yep, will do. :rocket:
